root.label: Hurricane Helene floods IPEX Woodfin site

events.label: Hurricane Helene floods IPEX Woodfin site

slots.name: maximum rainfall
slots.sentence: Hurricane Helene hit western North Carolina in late September 2024, dumping more than 30 inches (76 centimeters) of rain in some areas, triggering landslides, toppling trees, pushing buildings off their foundations and choking waterways.

slots.name: pipes swept away percentage
slots.sentence: Officials said 60% of pipes stored outdoors at the site, sandwiched between railroad tracks and the river, were swept away by the 2024 flood, but most were recovered fairly quickly.

slots.name: flood severity multiplier
slots.sentence: But the flooding from Helene was 10 times worse.

slots.name: financial losses
slots.sentence: The company closed the factory for a couple of months afterward, with losses “well over $100 million,” Pritchett said.

slots.name: repair investment
slots.sentence: It has since invested over $100 million to repair and strengthen the buildings, and now is studying ways to contain the pipes in future floods — something MountainTrue publicly urged for months.
